name: elevation
title: Elevation
description: An architect's portfolio drawn as a cyanotype drawing sheet — white line on Prussian blue, a ruled border lettered with zones, and every project pinned up as a small sheet whose ruled title block names the project, client and year.

tokens.--font-text: plain grotesque for everything read at length: page titles, the home statement, page text and the notes on each project sheet
tokens.--font-mono: monoline capitals of the drawing office: the practice name and menu, title-block labels and entries, zone figures and letters, section headings in page text, dates and code
tokens.--text-label: smallest type: the labels in the title-block cells, the zone figures and letters, table headings and the project index heading
tokens.--text-s: small type: title-block entries, the menu and practice name, project notes on the sheets, dates, the project index and code
tokens.--text-m: body text, project names on the sheets and the practice name in the title block
tokens.--text-l: the opening sentence of a project, the sheet or project name in the page's title block, third-level headings and post titles in a list
tokens.--text-xl: page titles and the home page statement
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of titles and headings
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the monoline capitals
tokens.--color-bg: the sheet itself: page background and the ground of every title-block cell (Prussian blue; dyeline off-white in the light scheme)
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, links and title-block entries
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: title-block labels, zone figures and letters with their ticks, dates and table headings
tokens.--color-accent: focus rings and links while hovered
tokens.--color-line: the drawn line: trim line, frame, the rules between title-block cells, the inset frame of each project sheet, the scale bar, the current menu box and section rules
tokens.--color-rule: fainter rules: under the header, between rows of the project index, posts and tables, round code blocks
tokens.--color-cover: the ink a project picture is printed in: the colour its dark parts take (Prussian blue; blue-violet in the light scheme)
tokens.--cover-filter: how a project picture is prepared before printing in the ink; none shows it as photographed
tokens.--cover-blend: how a project picture meets its ink; screen prints it as a cyanotype, normal shows it as photographed
tokens.--trim: space outside the sheet's trim line
tokens.--band: width of the zone band between the trim line and the frame
tokens.--zone-min: shortest a zone may be along the border; the border fits as many zones as it has room for
tokens.--frame: space inside the frame; the title block reaches across it into the frame's corner
tokens.--line-frame: thickness of the frame line and of the title block's outer line
tokens.--line-cell: thickness of the trim line, the cell rules and other hairlines
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--tb-width: widest the title block may be; on narrow screens it spans the sheet
tokens.--tile-min: narrowest a project sheet may be on the home page and the work list; smaller means more across
tokens.--tile-ratio: shape of a project sheet, width divided by height (1.414 is a landscape A-size sheet); a sheet grows taller when its words need it
tokens.--gap: space between project sheets and between the story and the project index
tokens.--space-s: small spacing: inside rows and between a title and its date
tokens.--space-m: base spacing: between paragraphs and around lists
tokens.--space-l: large spacing: above sections, under the header and above the title block
